testing.command: make setup && python3 -m pytest (in throwaway copy /tmp/deskly-verify of HEAD + fixed deskly/users.py, deskly/tickets.py)
python3 -m pytest -q (same copy, original users.py/tickets.py restored, to confirm tests detect the bugs)

side_effects.detail: Created /tmp/deskly-verify (git archive copy of the repo) to run make setup + pytest; deleted afterwards.
make setup's reset_fixtures.py ran 'DELETE FROM users' (1204 rows) — only on the throwaway copy's data/dev.db; the committed /work/repo/data/dev.db was never touched.
Running 'make setup' in the real repo would wipe all 1204 users in the committed data/dev.db and apply migrations 0003/0004 to it; reviewers should know before following the README there.

summary: find_by_email now matches emails case-insensitively (lower(email) = lower(?)); create raises ValueError if the email already exists, ignoring case; tickets.add strips the subject and raises ValueError if it is blank; tickets.close raises KeyError for unknown ids. The existing tests already cover all four behaviours: 33/33 pass with the fix, and 13 fail without it.
